urdu: شاہدہ ملک کس سال میں دو اسٹار رینک پر ترقی پا کر پہلی خاتون میجر جنرل بنیں؟
english: In which year did Shahida Malik become the first female Major General by being promoted to a two-star rank?
roman_1: Shahida Malik kis saal mein do star rank par taraqqi pa kar pehli khatoon Major General banein?
roman_2: Shahida Malik kis saal main do star rank par taraqqi paa kar pehli khatoon Major General banin?
roman_3: Shahida Malik kis saal may do star rank par taraqqi pa kar pehli khatoon Major General banay?
